# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen (at the end of volume 2)  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Fred Wright  <sub>[v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, dimples like little dents in cream, and a merry expression. She has black eyes and sleek, glossy black hair that her father allows her to wear up by age sixteen. Anne Shirley describes her as having 'soulful eyes' and a plump, graceful figure, though Diana herself worries about being too fat.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c26 P7](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0007), [v2 c29 P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)_

## Personality

Diana is an amiable, practical, and good-natured girl with a cheerful and affectionate disposition. While less imaginative than Anne, she is a loyal, devoted companion who enjoys fun, reading, and outdoor games. She is naturally polite, obedient to her strict mother, and prone to easy laughter.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017)_

## History

Diana meets Anne Shirley shortly after Anne's arrival at Green Gables, and the two eleven-year-old girls instantly swear an oath of eternal friendship in the Orchard Slope garden. They spend their childhood playing together, creating imaginative playhouses like 'Idlewild,' and attending Avonlea School. Their friendship faces a crisis when Anne accidentally serves Diana elder currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Diana to become drunk and leading Mrs. Barry to forbid them from playing together. However, after Anne helps save Diana's little sister Minnie May during an attack of croup, Mrs. Barry relents and allows them to resume their companionship. Diana attends Avonlea School alongside Anne, joins the story club, and participates in local concerts and the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Rather than attending Queen's Academy or college, Diana remains at home in Avonlea, where she eventually becomes engaged to Fred Wright.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c16 P58](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0058), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Orchard Slope by strict parents  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- Accidentally became intoxicated after drinking currant wine at Green Gables, leading to a temporary ban on her friendship with Anne  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c16 P49](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0049), [v1 c16 P58](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0058)</sub>
- Helped Anne care for her sister Minnie May during a severe attack of croup, restoring her mother's approval of their friendship  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Anne Shirley, as long as the sun and moon shall endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035)</sub>

> Indeed I will, and I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> I love you devotedly, Anne, and I always will, you may be sure of that.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> I never imagine things like that about places now, Anne. Don’t you remember how cross mother and Marilla were when we imagined ghosts into the Haunted Wood?  <sub>[v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009)</sub>

> It’s a very fine evening, but oh, I have such news, Anne. Guess. You can have three guesses.  <sub>[v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005)</sub>
